metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Titus in the gown you had, a share said once, and both locks shut.

yesterday: You were in Titus, in the gown you had. The plot knew the play.
The share is two-and-thirty shillings, said once. Michaelmas is still the last count.
Five mornings at nine, from Monday. The sixth is the opening.
Heminges and Bryan are named for the court money, and the money is not in the house yet.
Quiney still owes one pound. You did not ask him again. The debt stays his, apart from the company's tally.
The gowns went with the term. Margery's stair is hers.

Three nights stand. Stephen, the Navarre comedy. John, the lovers. Innocents, Errors. The thumb is out. Two hours and a half. After the fourth, a line changes only if a playing fault demands it. The Master is the sixteenth, at Clerkenwell.
The joke is struck out. You have not written the head. Nobody asked for the next page.
